tei:div.tei:p: 261)snyan brgyud las mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus kyi cha lag rdzogs chen gnad kyi me long bzhugs: dpal kun bzang klong la phyag 'tshal lo: gdod ma'i rig pa chos kyi sku: ka dag zang thal skye ba med: lhun grub snang ba ye shes ngang: gnyug ma blo 'das brjod pa bral: 'od gsal rig pa chos nyid dbyings: ye babs gzhi grol chos sku'i klong: man ngag kun gyi snying po mchog: rang rig ngo bo mtsho rgyal ma: smra med brjod bral rdzogs pa che: bsam gtan ting 'dzin mi dmigs pa: brjod 'das rig pa zang thal che: 'khor 'das gnyis med 'od gsal klong: shes rab chen po'i ye shes kyi: ka dag rgya yan phyogs lhung bral: 'od gsal rig pa pha mthar son: rol stsal 'gags med phyin bcu rdzogs: ma skyes rang byung don gyi lha: ma 'gags gsal stong zung 'jug rim gnyis kyi: nam mkha'i rang bzhin mtha' brgyad bral ba'i dbyings: skye med ngo bo ka nas dag pa che: chos nyid rig pa rgya yan mtha' dbus bral: so so ma yin tha mi dad pa'i klong: rang rig sku gsum mngon gyur gdod ma'i gzhir: 262)yum chen rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i rtsal rdzogs nas: sor rtogs ye shes chags bral dga' ba'i klong: dgongs pa zang thal mnyam nyid 'od gsal dbyings: spyod yul dag pa rab 'byams lha'i dkyil 'khor: dus gsum bde gshegs dgongs pa nam mkha'i klong: gsal sgrib bral ba 'od gsal dbu ma'i sbubs: 'di snang der gzung med pa gtad med ngang: lta ba'i ngo bo mthing 'od 'bar ma rtsal: rang rig skye med nam mkha'i rang bzhin du: khyab brdal klong yangs rtsol bral rang babs ngang: sgom pa'i ngo bo mkha' 'gro mthing 'od 'bar: gang shar rang grol nam mkhar sbrul mdud bzhin: gzung 'dzin rang dag re dogs mtshan ma bral: spyod pa'i ngo bo mkha' 'gro mthing 'od 'bar: rig stong spros bral rnga yab dpal ri'i dbus: 'khor 'das dag pa'i gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs: rdo rje bdun ldan rang klong chen po nas:

snang cha 'gags med sna tshogs cho 'phrul ngoms: zang thal rgya yan mkha' 'gro mthing 'od 'bar: rgyal ba kun yum bde chen stong pa'i mkha': shes rab rol pa 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: gcig 'dus rang rig mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal sku: dag pa sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum du 'jug: smin grol rim gnyis 263)rdzogs pa mthar phyin nas: gzhon nu bum sku'i rgyal sa zin pa dang: sku gnyis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang 'grub: 'gro kun sku gsum zhing la spyod par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa rdzogs chen gnad kyi me long 'di yang rig 'dzin padma'i rgyal tshab kun mkhyen bra wa mā tis rten 'brel gyi ched du dbang dang rdzogs rim bsdus tsam bris gsungs bka'i gnang ba thob pa dang: mchog sprul bstan pa'i nyi ma 'jigs med dpa' bo chen pos bka' bskul phebs tshe sprang mo dud 'gro lta bu'i tha shal ba de wa'i ming gis 'khrul snang brdzun gyi ri mor bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis shog // mtsho rgyal dbang bshad skabs kyi kha bsgyur ni/ da lan gyi skabs su babs pa rma rgyal nas ngo mtshar ba'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas spyan drangs pa'i zab chos mtsho rgyal sgrub thabs rlung sems dbang sdud kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa sogs dbang gi lhan thabs ltar ro// bde rdaur pas so// 264)
